attributes.name: ypy-browser-indicator
attributes.description: Shows the browser's own loading indicator (tab spinner, stop button) while the requests of this element run. Any value except `false` turns it on.

values.name: true
values.description: Show the browser indicator during the request.

values.name: false
values.description: Do not show it, even when boosted elements show it by default.

config.name: boostBrowserIndicator
config.description: Show the browser indicator for every boosted element, without writing `ypy-browser-indicator` on each one.
